films.title: 12 Honkeys
films.description: Sidewayz Films' scripted wakeboarding classic follows 17 riders as an escaped chain gang, mixing a comic storyline with full sections from many of the era's leading riders. Shot on 16mm film in 1999 and released in 2000, the complete film runs 54 minutes, 27 seconds.

sourceRecords.sourceDetails: Public, embeddable complete film on Sidewayz Films' official YouTube channel; exact runtime 54:27. The official description confirms the 1999 16mm shoot, 2000 release, and featured rider credits.
Sidewayz Films' first-party trailer page confirms that the film was shot in 1999 on 16mm and describes the scripted production and cast context.
Contemporary independent review confirms Sidewayz as producer, the scripted full-film format, 17 pro riders, and the 2000 release period.
Independent anniversary feature confirms the April 1, 2000 debut and identifies 12 Honkeys as a Sidewayz Films classic.

rights.basis: Catalog metadata and embed of Sidewayz Films' official YouTube upload; no media rehosting permission inferred. No reliable film-wide location list or director credit was published, so neither was inferred.
